label: Basic
description: Basic timeline. Best for the minimal composition: 3 entries, each a date, title and line of copy, with the first 2 marked done.

label: Roadmap
description: Roadmap timeline. Best for dates in a right aligned column beside each title and line.

label: Order Status
description: Order status timeline. Best for order stages where every step up to the current one fills its node with a check and later steps stay an empty ring.

label: Git Activity
description: Timeline with git activity. Best for a distinct icon inside each filled node, such as fork, pull request and merge, with the relative time under the description.

label: Milestones
description: Milestones on both sides. Best for entries that alternate either side of a centre line, each just a date and a title.

label: Pipeline Steps
description: Pipeline steps. Best for build stages with a check, spinner or circle node, a status coloured duration badge and a collapsible card per step, open on load.

label: Roadmap Items
description: Timeline with roadmap items. Best for newest first entries marked by small colored dots, each a tiny uppercase date over one line led by a muted verb.

label: Horizontal
description: Horizontal timeline. Best for dots and a line running left to right, with 3 phases side by side under the line.

label: Leading Labels
description: Horizontal timeline with dates above. Best for dates over the line and titles with copy under it, each phase a labelled tick.

label: Deployment Log
description: Deployment log timeline. Best for deploy runs with a green check or red cross node and a status badge, over a mono commit hash, branch and duration row.

label: Avatar Activity
description: Activity feed timeline with user avatars. Best for each event led by the actor's photo as its node, in one sentence that mutes the action between name and target.

label: Compact Milestones
description: Compact horizontal milestones. Best for versions across a row with check, play or circle nodes by status and a Current badge on the version in progress.
